verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a built-in `ros2` CLI suite for introspecting nodes, topics, and services, including echoing live topics, a graph daemon, topic statistics, service introspection, and parameter retrieval. These cover inspecting live topics and state. Remote inspection is only implied: community evidence mentions multi-machine systems and the QoS docs mention non-ideal networks, but nothing explicitly documents debugging a deployed robot from another machine. Log inspection is not evidenced at all. missing for 10: explicit documentation of remote/off-robot inspection workflows, log aggregation/viewing (e.g. a rosout log tool), hands-on corroboration of debugging deployed robots remotely
